mapper.select: SELECT field_id, form_id, field_key, label, field_type, options, required, sort_no FROM flow_form_field WHERE form_id = #{formId} ORDER BY sort_no ASC, field_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_form_field (form_id, field_key, label, field_type, options, required, sort_no) VALUES (#{formId}, #{fieldKey}, #{label}, #{fieldType}, #{options}, #{required}, #{sortNo})
